gloss: accident involving a person; rail accident

definitions.gloss: accident involving injury or death to a person
definitions.explanation: an accident where a person is injured or killed, especially on railways

examples.japanese: {人身事故|じんしんじこ}で{電車|でんしゃ}が{遅|おく}れている。
examples.english: The train is delayed due to a rail accident.

examples.japanese: {人身事故|じんしんじこ}のため、{運転|うんてん}を{見合|みあ}わせております。
examples.english: Service is suspended due to an accident involving a person.

examples.japanese: {中央線|ちゅうおうせん}で{人身事故|じんしんじこ}が{発生|はっせい}しました。
examples.english: An accident involving a person occurred on the Chuo Line.

notes:
COMPOUNDS:
{人身|じんしん} (person, human body) + {事故|じこ} (accident)

USAGE:
In Japan, this term is commonly heard in train announcements when service is disrupted. It is a euphemism that may include suicide cases, though it covers any accident involving a person on the tracks.

COMMON ANNOUNCEMENT PHRASES:
- 「{人身事故|じんしんじこ}のため、{運転|うんてん}を{見合|みあ}わせております」
  (Service is suspended due to an accident)
- 「{人身事故|じんしんじこ}の{影響|えいきょう}で{遅|おく}れが{出|で}ています」
  (There are delays due to an accident)

RELATED WORDS:
- {遅延証明|ちえんしょうめい} - delay certificate
- {振替輸送|ふりかえゆそう} - alternative transportation
- {運転再開|うんてんさいかい} - resumption of service
